sql.pred: SELECT actors.character , durations.duration FROM actors JOIN durations ON actors.actor_id = durations.actor_id
SELECT name FROM Songs WHERE genre = 'modern' OR language = 'English'
SELECT T1.name FROM Aircrafts AS T1 ORDER BY distance ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT e.employee\_id , e.job\_title , e.hire\_date , e.salary FROM Employees AS e WHERE e.salary >= 12000 ORDER BY e.salary DESC
SELECT T1.conference FROM Schools AS T1 JOIN Competition_Scores AS T2 ON T1.school_id = T2.school_id ORDER BY T2.acc_percent DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Students WHERE (Grade = 'B') OR (Grade = 'B+') OR (Grade = 'B-')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Tracks WHERE genre = 'rock'
SELECT T1.title , T1.film_id FROM Films AS T1 JOIN Inventory AS T2 ON T1.film_id = T2.film_id GROUP BY T1.film_id ORDER BY SUM(T2.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.car_maker_id , T1.car_maker_name FROM Car_Makers AS T1 JOIN Cars AS T2 ON T1.car_maker_id = T2.car_maker_id GROUP BY T1.car_maker_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT T2.car_model_id) > 2 AND COUNT(*) > 3
SELECT T1.order_date FROM Orders AS T1 JOIN Order_Items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id WHERE T2.quantity = 1
SELECT T1.name FROM Instructors AS T1 JOIN Student_Advisors AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.instructor_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT product\_id FROM Orders GROUP BY product\_id HAVING (COUNT(*) > 3) OR (SUM(quantity\_ordered) > 80000)
SELECT T1.city FROM Cities AS T1 JOIN Population AS T2 ON T1.city_id = T2.city_id JOIN Languages AS T3 ON T1.city_id = T3.city_id WHERE T3.language = 'English' ORDER BY T2.population DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.product_id FROM Problems AS T1 JOIN Problem_Closures AS T2 ON T1.problem_id = T2.problem_id WHERE T2.closure_authorised_by = "Ashley Medhurst" AND T1.reported_by = "Christop Berge"

SELECT T1.booking_start_date , T1.booking_end_date FROM Apartment_Bookings AS T1 JOIN Apartments AS T2 ON T1.apt_id = T2.apt_id WHERE T2.bedroom_count > 2

SELECT MAX(duration) FROM Actors

SELECT colleges.enrollment , colleges.primary_conference FROM colleges ORDER BY colleges.founded_year ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, date_opened, name, account_type, balance FROM Accounts
SELECT T1.ship_id , T1.name FROM Ships AS T1 JOIN Incidents AS T2 ON T1.ship_id = T2.ship_id GROUP BY T1.ship_id ORDER BY SUM(T2.injuries) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(page_size) FROM Products
